parole.significato: the uppermost part of a house or building
parole.testo: From over- + hus, from Old Norse yfirhús. The governmental sense is a calque of English upper house.

parole.significato: the lowest part of a house or building
parole.testo: From under- + hus, from Old Norse undirhús. The governmental sense is a calque of English upper house.
